text: Why is `result += "a"` in a loop quadratic?
choices: Each iteration allocates a new string and copies all existing characters
The compiler cannot optimize string literals
Garbage collection runs on every iteration
explanation: Iteration i copies i characters, so n iterations copy about n squared over two. For 40,000 characters that is 800 million character copies plus 40,000 allocations — measured at 79 ms against 1 ms for StringBuilder.
